correction: A dracut run that exits 0 does not prove a complete initramfs: dracut 106 skips its whole dependency-resolution pass when its temporary directory is named dracut.ko*, because find -not -path '*.ko*' then matches every path, and the initramfs ships with no libc and no dynamic loader. build_initramfs checks for libc.so.6 in the lsinitrd listing and runs dracut again, at most 3 times.
evidence: Floe publish run 43079965647 (job 130733865626): initdir /var/tmp/dracut.ko66MD, 'Resolving executable dependencies' took 11 ms against about 0.6 s in the passing jobs, the listing had 1269 files against 1330 and no ld-linux-x86-64.so.2 or libc.so.6, and the secure artifact validation failed with exit 127 when it ran systemd-gpt-auto-generator. Same 1230 package versions as the passing run 43074312789. Upstream fix: https://github.com/dracut-ng/dracut-ng/commit/5c53a810bbc983efeaec17d88ac06a697059a201 (dracut 109).
